name: resizable
title: Resizable
description: A two-panel split whose divider is grabbed by the cursor and dragged right, left, then back to the middle.
useWhen: Demonstrating a code and preview split layout with its ratio animating.
Showing a drag-to-resize interaction with handle hover and press states.
Visualizing before and after content that morphs its split point.
avoidWhen: You need fixed-width layout panels: plain CSS avoids the drag-state overhead.
The split is purely decorative: use a plain container instead.
You need more than two panels: compose several instances.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Split axis: panels side by side or stacked.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
